scope: Zenodo API and public repository recheck for a new synchronized hydrogen-refuelling station-to-vehicle raw trace

zenodo_api_recheck.retrieval: public API best-match pages inspected at record/file metadata level; raw files were not downloaded from candidate records
api_limitations: Zenodo type/filter query variants attempted during discovery returned HTTP 400; unfiltered records were therefore inspected and classified individually.
Search ranking is noisy and cannot establish eligibility without file-level and metadata inspection.

candidate_classifications.title: Thermodynamic modeling and simulation of subcooled liquid hydrogen refueling for transport applications
candidate_classifications.reason: The record is a publication with one PDF and no synchronized station-to-vehicle raw logger archive; it is not counted as validation data.

candidate_classifications.title: HCTGS v45 Israel — The Tower That Grows Downward
candidate_classifications.reason: No hydrogen-refuelling experiment or required process channels.

candidate_classifications.title: A generator-matrix model quantifies the limited contribution of measured biomarkers to human mortality acceleration — code and derived data
candidate_classifications.reason: Not hydrogen, fueling, storage, or station process data.

public_repository_followups.title: Experimental Dataset on the Absorption-Desorption Dynamics of an AB2 Metal Hydride Hydrogen Storage Tank for a 300 Watt PEM Fuel Cell
public_repository_followups.observed_content: Three Excel files at approximately one-second intervals with flow, pressure, five temperatures, cumulative volume and absorbed/desorbed hydrogen.
public_repository_followups.reason: A small AB2 metal-hydride tank experiment is not a compressed-gas HRS station-to-vehicle fill and has no dispenser, receptacle, cascade or vehicle protocol trace.

public_repository_followups.title: Experimental Data of Hydrogen Dispersion in an Open-ended Rectangular Channel
public_repository_followups.observed_content: Temporal mass flow, filling pressure and hydrogen concentration from 29 sensors; version 2, CC BY 4.0.
public_repository_followups.reason: This is dispersion/consequence evidence already represented by the repository's detector validation and does not contain vehicle fueling pressure-temperature-mass-flow traces.

claim_boundary: Discovery evidence only. No candidate is promoted to an independent full-loop validation holdout without synchronized required channels, initial conditions, protocol metadata, file hashes and reuse terms. Publication-only, component-only and already-consumed consequence data remain outside the full-loop gate.
next_action: Keep the independent full-loop gate open and request a de-identified logger export from NREL HITRF, JRC HYTRANSFER/GasTeF, CARB/HyStEP, NIST FTS or another custodian; freeze provenance and scoring before reading numerical outcomes.
